lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor fourteen. Ninety-six megawatts. Shield wall's signed off — forty of those ninety-six if you raise it.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Forty. For a screen that doesn't shoot.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It buys you time in one place. Whether that's worth browning out everything else is arithmetic, and I'd do the arithmetic first.
lines.beat: flags the trade honestly — it is currently a bad one, and LF-014 is open on exactly that

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Noted. Okonkwo, you've been quiet since nine.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: I've had the order about half out. I'd rather finish before I say anything.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: The one I read as hold. It isn't hold. It's closer to seal.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: That's the wall. Everything on the board just dropped forty percent to feed it.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Ring's thin. Whatever you're running that isn't shooting — drop it.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It's finished. It's not a defence order. Nobody was told to hold this network.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: To keep it shut. It's a quarantine order, Vasquez. Sixty-one doors and a list of which ones were still closed.
lines.beat: the act's reveal, delivered as a correction to a translation
